decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter was publicly showcased on the home page as a flagship of the firm's track-lighting direction, and it underpins compatibility across the system, so management's visible commitment and sunk engineering investment favour persisting with it.

This LED luminaire line sits close to the core offer with several models already invested in, and any weak sales can be attributed to temporary pandemic and supply-chain disruption, so management keeps it despite the typical turnover of luminaire ranges.

The home automation server box anchors the firm's announced move into smart home control, and dropping it would undercut earlier strategic justifications and existing customer installations, so the firm persists with it.

The luminaire family received its own dedicated page and represents a multi-model investment close to the established business, so visible commitment and sunk design costs lead management to retain it.
